Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)\"><span style=\"line-height:0\">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
